blockers: Gap-placement problem in nvar_transfer_from_1var_agree: cross_extend_bwd_1var produces witnesses with depth-d 2-var agreement relative to a SINGLE reference point, but the IH at depth d requires order matching relative to ALL env components simultaneously. This is circular: the IH needs order matching as input, but establishing order matching requires the IH at arity 2 (which also needs order matching for its own extension). The fundamental issue is that the theorem induction structure (on depth d only, with arity r universally quantified) does not provide enough IH strength to bridge the one-depth gap between what exist_transfer_from_full_agree provides and what the quantifier step needs.

continuation_context.critical_insight: The proof architecture needs restructuring. Three viable paths: (1) Mutual induction on (d,r) where the IH provides ALL arities at depth d AND arity r at depth d+1. (2) Strengthen nvar_transfer_from_1var_agree to take depth-(d+1) r-var agreement as ADDITIONAL input (from the existing ih_strong in the 2-var theorems). (3) Eliminate the standalone nvar_transfer_from_1var_agree entirely and inline the argument into prior_nonconstenv_2var_agree_until/since using a combined strong induction that simultaneously proves 2-var agreement AND provides the 3-var existential transfer at each depth.
